project_type: Standalone HTML content file (blog articles for WordPress)
verification_instructions: 1. Verify file has 21 article accordion-items. 2. Each article contains formatted HTML in code block (bold/italic/underline/mark tags). 3. Each article has img tag. 4. CTA buttons have inline SVG icons. 5. Each article has exactly 20 comma-separated single-word tags with # prefix. 6. Content is Week 2 (not Week 1).
setup_instructions: No setup needed - editing a standalone HTML file
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no external CDN access at runtime for the accordion page itself. However, the article HTML CODE inside pre/code blocks CAN reference external images (unsplash etc) since that code will be pasted into WordPress. The accordion page's own header/footer can use inline SVG for logos.
contribution_requirements: File must remain self-contained HTML. All CSS/JS inline. No external dependencies for the accordion page itself.
key_patterns: Accordion UI pattern with pre/code blocks containing escaped HTML article content. 3 copy buttons per article (title, article HTML, tags). Schedule badges: pagi (07:00), siang (12:00), sore (19:00). Tags stored in data-tags attribute space-separated for copy button.
directory_structure: M-App/ root contains the target HTML file alongside a React Vite app (unrelated to this task).
